scope: Aplicar no usuário lsi o adaptador GTK2 de cores de endpoint DomainOS e verificar seleção, módulo local, carregamento GTK2, recarga e reversão sem alterar outras famílias.

result.dynamic_palette: GTK2 resources regenerated from the current KDE GTK color export; no final RGB palette added

private_native_probe.runtime: GTK2 2.24.33 in isolated Xvfb; user HOME and GTK2 theme/palette; GTK_PATH and GTK_EXE_PREFIX unset
private_native_probe.diagnostic: Existing private-environment atk-bridge/libgail symbol warning only

rollback_preflight.engine_removal_order: The dynamic GTK2 recipe returns to stock pixmap before the per-user module is removed

limits: The user has not yet confirmed the visible result in their GTK2 applications.
The probe used Xvfb, not the historical HP VUE window; it verifies module discovery/loading and a real GTK2 scrollbar scene only.

The already-running irix-theme-companions.service was preserved. Its in-memory GTK2 renderer predates this change and may regenerate the DomainOS recipe with the previous pixmap engine after the next color-scheme event; updating/restarting that bridge remains pending.
Direct VUE endpoint interaction remains unauthorized under I517.
Horizontal/upper pressed states and historical thumb-drag measurements remain open.
No GTK3, GTK4, Qt, Kvantum, Plasma, panel, window decoration, VM, or theme selection setting was modified.

coverage_estimate.basis: Technical I167 coverage after user-local engine integration, palette-preserving RC generation, live module load, and rollback preflight; not a visual-fidelity score or human acceptance.
